MyChart Message - Medical Advice Request
From: Nguyen Thi Lan Huong
Sent 11/06/2026 7:42 PM   MRN 6143027

Hi, this is Lan Huong. After my infusion on Wednesday I have had tingling in both hands and it is worse with cold. I also noticed some mouth sores. Is this expected? Should I still come Monday? You can call me at 555-0182, or my son Daniel Nguyen at 555-0119 if I don't answer. We moved, new address is 4812 Larkspur Ct, Maplewood 55109. Thank you.

From: Infusion Nursing Team
Sent 11/07/2026 8:15 AM

Hello, thank you for letting us know. Cold-induced tingling is a known side effect of oxaliplatin; please avoid cold drinks and wear gloves outdoors. For the mouth sores, use the baking soda rinse 4 times daily and avoid spicy foods. Please keep your Monday appointment; the team will assess neuropathy grade before treatment and may adjust the dose. Call the clinic if you have fever over 100.4 F.
keep: Cold-induced tingling is a known side effect of oxaliplatin
note: Patient message with Vietnamese-order name, informal self-reference by given names, son with phone, new street address.
